evidence.quote: Does West Milford require an inspection on resale of a home? No. We do not require a Certificate of Continued Occupancy on the resale of home. A Smoke Detector Certification is required and is performed by the Fire Prevention Department; Please call 973-728-2840 to schedule an appointment.

resale_co.notes: The Building and Zoning FAQ says West Milford does not require a Certificate of Continued Occupancy on resale; only the smoke alarm and carbon monoxide alarm certification from the Fire Prevention Bureau is needed. An optional letter confirming no CCO is required costs $40 by written request. Underground oil tanks in use and not leaking may stay. No staff email addresses are published on the Township contact page; the Technical Assistant to the Construction Official is Alana Dille (973-728-2780).

requirements: Minimum 4-inch house numbers visible from the street (Township Ordinance 2009-021); no certificate without them
Smoke and CO alarms must be UL listed, less than 10 years old, and tested by the owner or agent before the inspection
Single-station battery smoke alarms must be 10-year sealed units; existing hardwired alarms must work and cannot be replaced with battery alarms

Hardwired requirements by build date: before 1977 sealed battery alarms on each level; 1977 to Feb 21, 1983 hardwired on sleeping levels and basement; Feb 22, 1983 to Apr 30, 1993 interconnected hardwired on every level; May 1, 1993 and later also inside every bedroom

Smoke alarm on each level within 10 feet of every bedroom door; basement alarm on the ceiling within 3 feet of the stairwell; wall-mounted alarms 6 to 12 inches below the ceiling; cathedral ceilings need an alarm within 12 inches of the peak
CO alarms required with any fuel-burning appliance, fireplace, woodstove or attached garage, centrally outside each sleeping area within 10 feet of every bedroom door (UL 2034)
A central-station monitored fire alarm installed at construction must be kept working; an NFPA 72 test report and proof of monitoring are required
Homes with solar, a backup generator or battery storage need a durable label (for example 'CAUTION: MULTIPLE SOURCES OF POWER') within 18 inches of the main panel and the meter
Fire extinguishers no longer required (since February 3, 2025)
Units opening onto a common hallway (for example Bald Eagle Commons) need working self-closers

authorities.how_to_apply: Apply through the Fire Prevention citizen services portal ('Apply for a Smoke Detector Cert', registration required) or call the Fire Prevention Bureau at 973-728-2840 to schedule; the office is at 13 Edgar Drive. Checks are payable to the Township of West Milford Fire Marshal. Scheduling hours are 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., Monday through Friday.
